title: Representative independence of the source-only stalk map
statement: For any cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-base-change], any derived K on X, K-flat sheaf complexes P,Q with eP:QP≅K and eQ:QQ≅K and invertible pullback counits, fix p in X' and i. Write rP,rQ for the two source-only maps [def-pc-affine-base-change-into-pullback]. There exists an additive equivalence t:source(rQ)≃source(rP) such that rQ(x)=rP(t(x)) for every x. No affine scheme or termwise quasi-coherence hypothesis is used, and no global module U,a,d is asserted.

proof.text: Apply exists_comparisonSourceIso to a=eQ followed by eP inverse. It supplies the tensor-algebra-linear isomorphism e between model cohomologies with the specified underlying derived transport. Extend e to the fourth stalk ring and forget scalars to obtain the additive equivalence t.
Apply comparisonIntoPullback_naturality to Q,P,a,e and the supplied K-flatness and invertible counits. This gives the commuting square into derived-stalk cohomology of pullback.

At every complex on X prime, compose comparisonStalkHomologyIso with affineRepresentativeStalkIso inverse. Naturality of these two isomorphisms gives a natural isomorphism after precomposition with Q. Mathlib Localization.liftNatIso descends it to an isomorphism delta between derived-stalk cohomology and the stalk of derived cohomology; liftNatTrans_app computes its components at Q(N). Naturality of delta along counit inverse followed by pullback(eN) rewrites affineBaseChangeIntoPullback(N) as comparisonIntoPullback(N), followed by derived-stalk cohomology of pullback(eN), followed by delta at pullback(K). This is proved in the private helper and hnormal; no new hole is used.

Postcompose the naturality square with cohomology of pullback(eP) and delta at pullback(K). Functoriality and eP inverse followed by eP equal to identity give pullback(a) followed by pullback(eP)=pullback(eQ). Substitute both normalization identities. The resulting morphism identity rQ=extension(e.hom) followed by rP evaluated at x is exactly the required equation for t.
